title: ReProAgent: Tool-Augmented Multi-Stage Agentic Generation of Bug Reproduction Tests from Issue Reports
datasets: SWT-Bench-Lite (paper and cached outputs: 267 issues; nominal benchmark commonly 276)
SWT-Bench-Verified (paper and cached outputs: 431 issues; nominal verified cohort commonly 500)
task: Repository-level issue reproduction test generation; generate tests failing on buggy pre-patch version and passing after ground-truth patch.
input_setting: Issue report and buggy repository; stages for hierarchical bug localization, execution-path root cause analysis, assertion-aware planning, test generation and Docker execution with triadic semantic review.
author_relationship_evidence: Public repository README uses the ReProAgent name and matching paper framework title/stages; contains source modules matching paper stages and explicitly lists precomputed GPT-5-mini results/prediction files for both datasets.
license: GitHub API reports license=null; no root LICENSE found. No license verified for the implementation.
exact_models: Primary: GPT-5-mini; source config uses mutable model alias gpt-5-mini, with no dated snapshot/version pin documented.
Additional paper runs: Qwen3-Coder, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.6; exact immutable checkpoint/deployment IDs not supplied.
weights_status: No finetuning reported. GPT-5-mini requires hosted OpenAI API. Paper names open-weight model families but does not identify exact immutable checkpoints or include their weights; source README requires an OpenAI-compatible endpoint/key.
evaluation_route: Public README documents uv sync, Python 3.10+, Docker (Neo4j optional/in-memory fallback), generation CLI, and SWT-Bench evaluation CLI. Public author repo includes substantive src/ implementation, tests, locked dependencies, precomputed evaluation reports and per-instance prediction JSONL. At pinned commit, GPT-5-mini predictions have 267 Lite and 431 Verified rows; report JSON records 156/267 and 303/431 resolved. Static inspection only; no code executed and no paid API calls.
blockers: Paper/source outputs cover 267 Lite and 431 Verified instances, below nominal 276 and 500; paper does not explain exclusion policy. This makes comparison denominators unclear.
Paper Table 8 Verified localization groups total 430 (170 correct + 260 incorrect), while headline/table dataset total is 431; one instance is unaccounted for.

Cached Verified report JSON says completed_instances=0 while resolved_instances=303, unresolved_instances=128 and error_instances=0; report metadata needs reconciliation before treating it as a validated oracle.

GPT-5-mini alias is mutable; exact dated model snapshot, API configuration, prompts/run manifest and stochastic repeat policy are not pinned. Full generation needs a paid hosted endpoint; reported mean cost is $0.14 per instance (roughly $97.72 for the 698 cached prediction rows, estimate only).
Repository has no verified root license. Full benchmark replay requires old per-project Docker environments and substantial compute.
concept_fit: Very high: explicit root-cause hypothesis with execution paths, minimal trigger conditions, environment setup and expected assertions; strongest direct alignment to concept-guided bug-revealing tests among the current SWT candidates.
recommendation: Strongest current concept-aligned SWT-Bench candidate for reading its method and adapting evaluation questions, with public code and cached predictions. Exact full reproduction is conditional: resolve 267/276 and 431/500 cohort differences, Table 8 missing instance and cached Verified report inconsistency; pin GPT-5-mini route and license. It is not a Defects4J/BugsInPy study.
supporting_locations: Pinned Git tree includes src/ pipeline, tests/, pyproject.toml and uv.lock; root README generation/evaluation commands and model/API requirements.
